description: Transform2/3, Projective2/3, Affine2/3 (geometry/transform*.rs): try_inverse, transform_point, transform_vector, inverse_transform_*, products with isometries, similarities, unit quaternions and transforms

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: affine2_try_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: affine3_try_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: projective2_try_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: projective3_try_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: affine2_transform_point
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: affine2_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: affine3_transform_point
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: affine3_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: projective3_transform_point
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: projective3_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A + 2 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: affine3_inverse_transform_point
ops.tolerance: ceil(6 + 10 * A + 4 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: affine3_inverse_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: ceil(6 + 10 * A + 4 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: projective3_inverse_transform_point
ops.tolerance: ceil(6 + 10 * A + 4 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: affine2_mul_isometry2
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: isometry2_mul_affine2
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: affine3_mul_isometry3
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

inputs.name: iso
inputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k))

ops.name: isometry3_mul_affine3
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

inputs.name: iso
inputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k))

ops.name: affine3_mul_unit_quaternion
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: similarity3_mul_affine3
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

inputs.name: sim
inputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k), scaling)

ops.name: projective3_mul_affine3
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: affine3_div_projective3
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 8 * A + 4 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
